import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Calculate the forward-adjusted close prices
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors
    
    # Initialize the weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(np.zeros_like(prices), index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)
    
    # Calculate the simple returns for the last 20 days
    returns = adjusted_prices.pct_change(periods=20)
    
    # Calculate the sample standard deviation of the returns
    std_dev = returns.std(ddof=1)
    
    # Calculate the momentum signal
    momentum = (adjusted_prices / adjusted_prices.shift(21)) - 1
    
    # Apply the sign function to the momentum signal
    sign_momentum = np.sign(momentum)
    
    # Calculate the scaling factor
    scaling_factor = np.minimum(1, 0.10 / (std_dev * np.sqrt(252)))
    
    # Calculate the raw weights
    raw_weights = sign_momentum * scaling_factor
    
    # Normalize the weights to sum to 1 for each row
    normalized_weights = raw_weights.div(raw_weights.sum(axis=1), axis=0)
    
    # Set the weights to zero for the first 20 rows
    weights.iloc[:20] = 0
    
    return weights
